question: India's first Vista dome jungle safari train was launched in which state in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• India's first **Vista Dome Jungle Safari Train** was launched in **Uttar Pradesh** on **May 2025**. 
• The train is designed to provide an immersive experience for tourists, offering panoramic views of the **Chambal Valley** and other scenic landscapes. 
• It features **glass-ceiling coaches**, large observation windows, and rotating seats to enhance the sightseeing experience. 
• This initiative aims to boost **eco-tourism** and attract travelers to explore the rich **biodiversity and wildlife** of the region.
